read.thesis: Credit-card lender with net charge-offs of 6.06% (97bp above 2017-19 average) and rising delinquencies; management guides FY24 EPS $8.45-8.55 on assumed late-fee rule non-implementation, with no supply-side capacity signals.

triggers.label: Net charge-off rate 6.06% vs 4.60% prior year
triggers.quote: our net charge-off rate was 6.06% in the third quarter versus 4.60% in the prior year

triggers.label: Purchase volume down 3% to 7%
triggers.quote: Platform purchase volume growth range between down 3% and down 7% year-over-year

triggers.label: FY24 EPS $8.45-8.55 after ~$0.80 lift
triggers.quote: Synchrony expects to deliver fully diluted earnings per share between $8.45 and $8.55 for the full year 2024

triggers.label: Late-fee rule uncertainty persists
triggers.quote: there continues to be uncertainty regarding the timing and outcome of late fee related litigation

guidance.quote: Synchrony expects to deliver fully diluted earnings per share between $8.45 and $8.55 for the full year 2024
should result in low single-digit decline in purchase volume for the fourth quarter
we continue to expect our year-end 2024 reserve rate to be generally in-line with the year-end 2023 rate
We also continue to expect the second half 2024 net charge-off rate will be lower than the first half.

red_flags.label: Net charge-offs well above historical average
red_flags.quote: our net charge-off rate was 6.06% in the third quarter versus 4.60% in the prior year and 97 basis points above our historical average

red_flags.label: Late-stage collections worse than pre-pandemic
red_flags.quote: it is still performing worse than 2019 and 2020, the pre-pandemic period

evasions.topic: Late fee rule rollback and litigation timing
evasions.quote: we are not in the prediction business today
we are not going to break out the individual components of the PPPCs by line items
